feature_semantics_reopening_event.reason: The prior declared balance.omnibus ('max_absolute_eligible_feature_smd over all f0-f11') treated all twelve features, including the eight publisher-defined categorical tokens (f1/f3/f4/f5/f6/f8/f9/f11), as continuous quantities eligible for SMD. This is superseded, not silently reused: SMD is defined only for the four continuous features (f0/f2/f7/f10); the eight categorical features get a category-distribution diagnostic (total variation distance) instead. No execution occurred under the old single-omnibus design (execution_state was already DEFERRED_T03_C), so there is no stale run to mark -- this reopening amends the not-yet-executed algorithm contract itself, in place of the superseded 'balance.omnibus' field below.

d33_scope_amendment.reason: This entire randomization_calibration block (the 2,000-draw design-null permutation protocol below, and any X->T predictability calibration built on it) is an optional/P1 internal diagnostic per D33, not a T16/pre-test-freeze precondition. Randomization evidence comes primarily from the documented publisher/experimental assignment mechanism, not from this calibration. Mandatory T03 evidence instead: descriptive ED-03/ED-03b balance (non-blocking, reported as INFO) and ED-05 arm support (a genuine STOP/UNSUPPORTED_METRIC gate). This block is retained, not deleted, for anyone who chooses to run the optional protocol.

randomization_calibration.no_documented_block_rule: full development population is one block

classifier.feature_representation: fold-local LightGBMFeatureTransform (D32): categorical vocabulary fit on each fold's training side only, applied to that fold's OOF validation side; f0/f2/f7/f10 stay float64

balance.joint_omnibus_rule: continuous max-SMD and categorical max-TVD are never combined via max() or any other joint statistic; they are different quantities on different scales (D32). A joint disposition/action rule is unspecified and must not be invented.
